_comment: Voiceover for each Short. `at` is seconds into the rendered video; aim a line
to land just after the thing it describes appears, never before.
WORD BUDGET. The Windows voice reads at ~2.2 words/sec, so a 30s Short affords
about 45-50 words TOTAL once you leave room to breathe. The first draft of this
file ran to 91 words over an 11s video and every segment talked over the next.
narrate.mjs warns when they collide — believe it, and cut words rather than
Numbers are spelled out: a synthesiser reads '2,587' as 'two comma five eight
seven', and 'API' as a word rather than letters.

`pace` is ms per beat for render-video.mjs. It is here rather than in the renderer because video length and narration length have to agree: too fast and lines talk over each other, too slow and the Short ends in silence. Each value below puts the last word about three seconds before the final frame.

segments.text: You just added an M C P server.

One in three works. All of them read your keys.

This one is malicious. Watch what it takes.
Five credentials. It asked for nothing.
Same server, through the gateway. Nothing sensitive.
Same shell. One of them got your keys.
Free and open source. Link below.
Where does your context window actually go?
Every server injects its whole schema. Every turn.
I measured ninety one of them. The median costs two and a half thousand tokens.
Ten servers is twenty six thousand, before you type.
The gateway is flat. Two thousand six hundred.
Stop pasting J SON into your M C P config.
One entry replaces all of them.

Connect one. Its tools are live.
You pay that wait once. Not at every launch.
